name: nasa-sim-data-layer
description: NASA data layer (POWER, Images, InSight) with caching proxy and offline snapshots for a Moon/Mars simulation

scripts.normalize: node server/normalize.js data/raw_mars.json --out ../data/cached_mars.json && node server/normalize.js data/raw_moon.json --out ../data/cached_moon.json
scripts.snapshot: npm run snapshot:moon && npm run snapshot:mars
